list.des_phrases_pas_des_automatismes_muets: Sentences, not silent automation: every pass leaves a journal, and no automatic email goes out without a human click.
list.aucune_regle_pour_l_instant: No rules yet. A rule is a sentence: “No appointment for 15 days → create a task for the advisor”.
list.dernier_passage_resultat: Last pass on {when}: {matched} matched, {done} done, {skipped} skipped.
list.le_cron_quotidien_evalue_aussi: The daily pass — before 9:00 am, with send resumption — also evaluates these rules: it prepares, it never sends.

wave.relis_puis_envoie_les_garde_fous_sont_re: The automatic emails prepared by your rules. Review, then send: every safeguard (stop, unsubscribe, cap) is re-checked at send time.
wave.interrupteur_coupe_rien_ne_partira: The master switch is off (Settings → Automatic sending): nothing will go out.
wave.hors_heures_de_bureau: Outside office hours ({start}:00–{end}:00, weekdays, {timezone} time). You can still send: your click decides.

editor.une_phrase_un_declencheur_une_action: One sentence: a trigger, a threshold, conditions, one action.
editor.il_devient_le_titre_des_taches: It becomes the title of created tasks and reads in the journal.
editor.tout_ce_qui_n_est_pas_coche_vaut_peu_imp: Anything unchecked means “any”. Conditions combine with AND; a list reads “at least one of”.
editor.porte_au_moins_une_de_ces_etiquettes: Has at least one of these tags
editor.fait_partie_d_au_moins_une_de_ces_cibles: Belongs to at least one of these audiences
editor.suivi_par_l_un_de_ces_conseillers: Followed by one of these advisors
editor.est_un_partenaire_de_l_une_de_ces_profes: Is a partner of one of these professions (same email address)
editor.aucune_profession_de_partenaire: No professions filled in on your partners.
editor.variables_permises: Variables in braces are replaced at preparation time; any other brace is refused.
editor.opt_in_j_ai_relu_ce_gabarit: I have read this template in full and allow this rule to prepare automatic sends. Nothing goes out until a person reviews the wave and clicks.
editor.rappel_vague_rien_ne_part_sans_clic: Automatic sending: the rule PREPARES a wave of drafts. The wave shows on the rules screen and only goes out from a human click, safeguards re-checked.
editor.gabarit_version_n: Template version {n} (versions are frozen: editing creates the next one)
editor.sans_gabarit: No template (this action writes no email)

actions.create_task: Create a task for the advisor
actions.prepare_draft: Prepare a draft on the contact page

journal.fait_ou_pas_fait_et_pourquoi: Every pass, every contact: done, or not done and why.
journal.rien_pour_ces_filtres: Nothing for these filters — the engine has done nothing yet, or not that.

contactPanel.actifs_une_reponse_ou_un_rendez_vous_les: Automatic sending active — a reply, an appointment or an unsubscribe stops it.

actions.regle_archivee: Rule archived — its journal and tasks remain.
actions.evaluation_faite: Evaluation done: {matched} contacts matched, {done} actions done, {skipped} skipped (reasons in the journal).
actions.evaluation_deja_en_cours: An evaluation is already running — its result is coming.
actions.vague_envoyee: Wave processed: {sent} sent, {canceled} rejected (reasons on contact pages), {remaining} remaining.
actions.envois_arretes: Automatic sending stopped for this contact.
actions.envois_rearmes: Automatic sending re-armed for this contact.

settingsCard.rien_ne_part_sans_clic_la_vague_se_relit: Rules prepare; a person reviews the wave and clicks. Nothing goes out on its own.
settingsCard.interrupteur_general: Allow rules to prepare automatic sends
settingsCard.coupe_send_email_ne_prepare_rien: Off: the “automatic send” action prepares nothing and the wave refuses to go. Tasks, notifications and drafts continue.
settingsCard.au_plus_un_email_automatique_par_contact: At most one automatic email per contact per period, all rules combined.
settingsCard.jours_ouvres_dans_le_fuseau: Weekdays (Monday–Friday), in the {timezone} time zone. Outside the window, the wave screen warns — the click decides.

queries.annule_fiche_supprimee: Canceled when sending the wave: the contact was deleted.
queries.annule_arrete: Canceled when sending the wave: automatic sending is stopped for this contact.
queries.annule_desinscrit: Canceled when sending the wave: this address is unsubscribed.
queries.annule_plafond: Canceled when sending the wave: this contact’s automatic email cap is reached.

notifications.subject: Rule “{rule}”: {contact}
notifications.body: The “{rule}” rule of {organization} matched {contact}. The contact page:
